_about: Pipeline site list. Fields id, name, lat, lon, description, psr_distance_km and nasa_avg_illumination_pct follow docs/CONTRATO_DE_DADOS.md (sites.json). The other fields record provenance. Coordinates are regional reference points, NOT NASA-designated landing sites. lat/lon: degrees, MOON_ME (DE421 mean Earth/polar axis), east-positive longitude in [-180, 180).

sites.name: Shackleton rim
sites.description: Regional reference point: centre of the LOLA 5 m DEM region 'Shackleton Rim' (Site04). Not a NASA-designated landing site.

source.document: NASA M2M-30044 Moon to Mars Lunar Surface Data Book, Baseline, effective 2025-03-18 (NASA/TP-20250002845)
source.location: Appendix A2.1, Table A2.1-1 Lunar South Pole Features, page 75 of 93

sites.cross_check: Matches the centre of PGDA product 78 Site04_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif (pipeline/sites/verify_site_points.py).

sites.name: Connecting ridge
sites.description: Regional reference point: point CR1/C1 on the Shackleton - de Gerlache connecting ridge used in NASA Lunar Surface Data Book traverse examples. Not a NASA-designated landing site.

source.document: NASA ACD-50044 Lunar Surface Data Book, Initial Release, effective 2022-10-06
source.location: Page 26 of 43, figure caption (HEOMD-410 Example 6), and page 32 of 43, section 7.3.3; repeated in M2M-30044 (2025), figure 7.3.2.7-1, page 54 of 93

sites.cross_check: Published as 222.6° E (0-360); stored here as 222.6 - 360 = -137.4. About 150 m from the Site01 region centre (-89.4632, -137.49) in Table A2.1-1 of M2M-30044 (pipeline/sites/verify_site_points.py).
